messages:
Jordan: Hey team — MerchantLabs POC asking for a 40% off list rate for a 6mo dedicated commit (8 GPUs). They say conversion to prod in Q1 if price is right. Attached numbers: commit = 6 months, 8xA10, estimated ~6M tokens/day. Need deal desk approval or alternative structuring. Quote link: https://redwood/quotes/ML-981

Nick: Can you paste the ARR / committed $ and the current quote line items? Also why 40% vs our standard 25-30%? Need business justification for >30%.

Jordan: Quick numbers: list = $180k for 6mo, customer asking to land at ~$108k (40% off) => they claim competitor offered ~35% + 60d pilot. ARR-equivalent for us ~ $120k over 6mo after usage. They also want the onboarding fee waived.

Emily: Timeline context — POC wraps 2024-04-15, they want prod by 2024-06-01. Security asks for SOC2 and an option for VPC/dedicated. SLA requested 99.9%.

Sanjay: Tech check — 8x A10G as a dedicated pool should cover their throughput if they accept batching; rough estimate 150 RPS for our gen model. If they insist on <100ms tail latency for interactive use, we’ll likely need 12 GPUs or a smaller model. Also confirm KV cache persistence and whether they need KV snapshots retained.

Lisa: Legal note — we'll require a completed security questionnaire + SOC2 report before finalizing. No legal objection to discount itself but onboarding fee waiver and changes to MSA terms need SOW addendum.

deploy-bot: Pricing playbook lookup: max delegated discount = 30%. Discounts >30% require CRO/CFO approval and deal desk justification. Refer: https://redwood/company/pricing-playbook#discounts

Nick: Proposal from DealDesk: offer 35% off list only if customer prepays 50% up front and signs a 6mo commit + quarterly business review cadence; onboarding fee waived conditional on signed prepay by EOM. Otherwise stick to 30% with onboarding fee of $5k. Jordan — can you push prepay?

Jordan: I can get them to prepay 50% contingent on competitor counter. They also asked if we can provide $10k usage credit instead of deeper % off — would that be acceptable to finance?

Nick: Credits are acceptable as an alternative to deeper discount. For approval path: I can provisionally approve up to 35% with CFO sign-off. Please include these exact quote fields: `prepay=50%`, `commit=6mo`, `onboarding_fee=0 (conditional)`, `usage_credit=$10k (optional)`, `quarterly_biz_review=true`. Then send updated SOW to Legal.

Lisa: I'll draft the SOW addendum and add the SOC2 upload field to the checklist. Also need customer network diagram and PO/treasury contact for prepay.

Jordan: Got it — updating the quote now, will ping once customer confirms prepay. MerchantLabs legal asked for 60 days review window.

Nick: Marking this as discount-escalation for tracking. If prepay is signed by 2024-04-28, DealDesk will escalate to CFO for final sign-off and authorize 35% and onboarding waiver. Otherwise we revert to 30% + implementation fee. :thumbsup:
